notes: Fixed: the calendar’s categories and key had gone missing from the calendar page in Screens
Fixed: setting up a brand-new family’s Google Sheet could fail at the calendar categories

The Setup website is now the Family Dashboard configurator: Home and Help, then Set up (Setup wizard, Screens, Family, Rewards, Advanced), then the Apps. The title stays the same; each page has its own heading
Home: your dashboard’s status, the three parts explained with buttons, and a pointer to the Setup wizard
Family: a family name (e.g. MacMillan) – “The MacMillan family (Ben, Josh, Alex, Russ, Becky)”
Daily to-dos (was morning to-dos): daily on the days you pick, or weekly – stays ticked until it resets on the day you choose (e.g. TTRS, Numbots, drums, resetting on Saturday)
Rewards: clearer menu – Tasks, Daily to-dos, Reminders, Reward rules, Manual edits; a child’s widget points you to the Rewards tab

Advanced → Software updates: whether each part is up to date (the application held within Google, the dashboard screen, the website and apps), what’s new in the latest version, and the full version history
Bigger, clearer headings and text throughout the website
